headline: Distillery Tour and Racing Event Reservation Guide
reservation: Distillery tours and Churchill Downs racing events require separate advanced bookings; bourbon tours often fill weeks in advance. During the Kentucky Derby period, accommodation and event access are severely restricted and require official ticketing via Churchill Downs.

days.title: Bluegrass Racing and Main Street History

stops.name: Churchill Downs
stops.detail: Visit the Kentucky Derby Museum to explore the history of the legendary thoroughbred races.

stops.name: Louisville Slugger Museum & Factory
stops.detail: See the production of iconic wooden bats on Museum Row, marked by the world's largest steel bat.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; city traffic conditions vary
days.note: Check the racing calendar; the track is active during specific Spring, September, and Fall meets.

days.title: Whiskey Row and Victorian Architecture

stops.name: Old Forester Distillery
stops.detail: Experience a guided tour of an active urban distillery located in a restored 19th-century building.

stops.name: Old Louisville
stops.detail: Walk the gas-lit streets of St. James Court to view one of the largest concentrations of Victorian mansions in the US.

days.driving: Allow 30 minutes; local street parking varies
days.note: Walking is the best way to see Old Louisville's intricate brickwork and gardens.

days.title: Limestone Caverns and River Views

stops.name: Louisville Mega Cavern
stops.detail: Explore the man-made underground space via tram to learn about the region's geological history.

stops.name: Big Four Bridge
stops.detail: Walk this converted railway pedestrian bridge for elevated views over the Ohio River and city skyline.

days.driving: Allow 40 minutes; bridge access is pedestrian only
days.note: The Mega Cavern maintains a consistent temperature; a light jacket is suggested for the underground tour.

intel.title: Downtown Garages
intel.text: Ample parking is available in the West Main District garages, though street parking is metered. Check local signs for game-day restrictions near the arena.

intel.title: Urban Coverage
intel.text: Reliable 5G/LTE is available throughout the metropolitan area. Signal may drop within the deep limestone recesses of the Mega Cavern.

intel.title: Regional Access
intel.text: Fuel stations are frequent throughout the city and near SDF airport. If heading to the Bourbon Trail, refuel in the metropolitan area.

intel.title: Derby Congestion
intel.text: The two weeks leading up to the first Saturday in May see extreme congestion and surge pricing. Plan museum visits outside of this window for a quieter experience.

intel.title: Distillery Availability
intel.text: Most urban distilleries on Whiskey Row require reservations for interior tours. Walk-in retail access is usually available during business hours.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at SDF; it is a 15-minute drive to the West Main District hotels. NuLu and the Highlands are the primary supply hubs.
plan.vehicle: Compact or standard cars are ideal for city navigation; RVs should use designated peripheral lots for Churchill Downs.
plan.goldenHour: Big Four Bridge for sunset over the Ohio River, noting visibility varies by season.
